scenario.description: Profile the remaining CPU-mock journal validation cost at 32 retained records; preserve complete validation.
scenario.successCriteria: Identify measured hotspots and validate any one-at-a-time optimization without weakening journal semantics.

profilingResults.tool: Go pprof CPU profile with race instrumentation
profilingResults.command: VELA_RUN_CPU_MOCK_CAMPAIGN=1 VELA_CPU_MOCK_WAVES=4 VELA_CPU_MOCK_WIDTH=8 VELA_CPU_MOCK_TIMEOUT=5m go test -race -tags=integration ./internal/integration -run ^TestCPUMockProductionLoopJobCampaign$ -count=1 -timeout=8m -cpuprofile=/tmp/vela-startup-validation.syiSMk/journal-profile.cpu -o /tmp/vela-startup-validation.syiSMk/journal-profile.test -v
hotspots: 147.36 CPU sample seconds over 108.17 wall seconds; percentages are not wall-time partitions
complete candidate verification: 9.11 cumulative sample seconds
observeCPULoad: 17.28 cumulative sample seconds; observer perturbs load
runtime._ExternalCode: 45.38 flat seconds; not attributed wholesale to application or race

decision.rationale: Retain the single lookup-order change: historical identity/renewal and full regressions pass; race median improves 15.3%, no-race median 4.2% in three-run comparisons. Stop further micro-optimization; diagnose the retained old-version stale failure and campaign/production clock policy discrepancy before custody integration.
